==============================================
wildcard as a param name
==============================================

param x _ ;

---

(source_file
  (param
    (type
      (identifier))
    (wildcard)))

==============================================
identifier with brackets as a param name
==============================================

param x y [] ;

---

(source_file
  (param
    (type
      (identifier))
    (identifier)))

==============================================
underscore as a component name
==============================================

component x _ ;

---

(source_file
  (component
    (type
      (identifier))
    (identifier)))
